result.topic_en:
Hilbert shows that the discriminant $D_0$ of a number field is divisible by $D_U^{\mu}$, where $D_U$ is the discriminant of a subfield. He splits the discriminant determinant of conjugates into a sum of determinants and expands each into $
u$-rowed minors.
